units.source_text: 在被惊动的鸟儿的振翅声中，我目不斜顾，一边躲闪树墩子，一边攀登。

en.t: Amid the flapping wings of startled birds, I climbed on, looking straight ahead and dodging tree stumps as I went.

units.source_text: 我感到这种什么也不思索的攀登，忽然治愈了我。

en.t: I felt that this climb, in which I thought of nothing at all, had suddenly healed me.

units.source_text: 到达山顶的时候，一阵清凉的夜风，吹拂着我的汗涔涔的躯体。

en.t: When I reached the summit, a cool night wind brushed over my sweat-soaked body.
